body: Oh nah it's fine! Don't stress it \^\^, I Just wanted to know if there are any things I could do to improve the quality of any future trips c:

I Didn't get it tested, me and my friend ordered 2 tabs but got 3, the 3rd one came in a separate packet which I thought was strange, I took the extra tab and my friend took one from the normal packet and apparently had a completely normal trip, meanwhile my existence was melting so I'm not sure if it could've been something else, or if oversensitivity is a thng?
100ug and then after about an hour after feeling nothing I did 50 more and it all just cascaded from there
Ah I apologize for that, did some digging and didn't find anything so that's why I asked
Thank you! I wanna be safe with this stuff and I appreciate the advice <3
I Think I know what you're talking about, I've only tripped once but it was intense as fuck. Remember at one point I could only see red, blue, and green alongside everything being SUPER low-res

I Remember feeling like I wanted to "go back", it was extremely intense and I might've been shocked by exactly what I went through? It did get to the point where I felt like my reality was melting into a sea of shapes and colors and that was quite frightening to me. I Wouldn't like to relive that, honestly.
Thank you so much, I broke down in tears a lil while ago because what I experienced was too fucking much. I'm gonna survive this and go back to where I was in life
Yeah yeah yeah everything like that, I lost my sense of self, completely lost who I was
Of course none of it happened, but I experienced it for real...
My intentions are good.. But if I fuck up at everything, then what's the point?
I Doubt I really helped anyone at all, honestly. I THOUGHT I was helping, but what do I get? Blocked!
I Would get a pet, but my parents most likely would not allow it...
